h13.

`*markdown.service` (Goldmark-backed) — `v1.NewAPIV1Service` constructs it with tag and mention extensions, then `server.NewServer` passes it to RSS — `APIV1Service.MarkdownService`, `RSSService.MarkdownService`, and the unconstructed `memopayload.Runner.MarkdownService` field. See `internal/markdown/markdown.go`, `server/router/api/v1/v1.go`, `server/server.go`, `server/router/rss/rss.go`, `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`.
